description: cfd_2d_cylinder_singlephase on 2 ranks with adaptive refinement: the cells within 4 cells of the cylinder (G 25 4) and the vorticity of the boundary layer and the wake (G 26 1), regrid every 2 steps. The new patches of a regrid cast the cylinder at their resolution, their force objects are made anew (P 81 on both ranks, the pieces of a patch on the rank that holds it).
covers: cfd_amr::regrid: patch_geometry of the new patches
cfd_amr::free_patch: the force objects of a patch
cfd_amr::patch_forces on 2 ranks (the sums over the ranks of force_calc)
